correctness.rationale: Independent static frequencies with covariance σ²I give normalized equilibrium reference-phase loss tr(L_F^-2), not tr(L_F^-1) or centered tr(L_F^-1 P L_F^-1). The grounded path splits into two one-pinned/free-end blocks and one two-pinned block. Their exact inverses G_DN(p,q)=min(p,q) and G_DD(p,q)=min(p,q)(n+1−max(p,q))/(n+1) have Frobenius squares B(n)=n(n+1)(n²+n+1)/6 and J(n)=[2(n+1)^4+5(n+1)^2−7]/180. Strict forward convexity of B balances exterior gaps, reducing all finite N>=3 to one explicit minimum. Uniform quartic approximation on the gap simplex has a unique minimizer with middle-to-exterior ratio cbrt(15), giving pin fractions 1/(2+cbrt(15)) and its reflection and normalized loss 1/[6(2+cbrt(15))^3]. Independent exact Fraction Green-kernel sums verified all block lengths 0..8. This is a static linear model, not nonlinear Kuramoto with finite reset rate.
